components.label: evals/tasks/*/tests/baseline
components.sublabel: other commits' manifests, byte for byte

cards.title: Why
items: #75 tried to bump vitest inside one baseline; merged, every trial of that task would have scored 0
The copies are regenerated from git by evals/build.ts and must match the parent commit exactly

cards.title: How
items: An npm entry scoped to the baseline directories with ignore: dependency-name "*" and no version-update pull requests
GitHub documents ignore as applying to security updates for the manifests it covers
